title: Service agreement — business-day amendment
effect_basis: Synthetic scenario assumes execution and effectiveness on 6 January 2027.

insurance.quote: Supplier must provide insurance evidence two Business Days after the effective date.

followup.quote: Customer must review insurance evidence three days after its delivery deadline.

baseline_business_day_rule.quote: Business Day means Monday to Friday, including public holidays.

evidence.quote: Business Day means Monday to Friday, including public holidays, but excludes 7 January 2027.

sections.reason: This paragraph supplies the proposed operative change.

after.verbatim: Business Day means Monday to Friday, including public holidays, but excludes 7 January 2027.
